collection.description: A child sorts pebbles by color beside the shore.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), a child, sorts pebbles by color beside the shore. A friend suggests changing the rules halfway through.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), a child, sorts pebbles by color beside the shore. The game ends only when the tide reaches their feet.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), a child, sorts pebbles by color beside the shore. One particularly pretty stone is carried home as a keepsake.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), a child, sorts pebbles by color beside the shore. The first attempt fails spectacularly, provoking laughter.
